wholePhysicalScope: Mapped palace outline and inner court, unchanged coastal terrain, published recent Qualla frontage photo, and the exact dated public-domain archival view.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the open courtyard, eight seaward arches, twin towers and terrace staircases.
limitations: An exterior reconstruction of the standing palace. Tower levels, small rear openings and the decorative metalwork are estimated from the available references. The garden, detached pavilions and interior galleries are outside the building model.
